sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited data type has no possible values, so an empty case over it is exhaustive and can produce any result type.
sketches.resonance: From a presence that can never exist, every conclusion is formally permitted.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference under ARC does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the object has no strong owners.
sketches.resonance: What is not held strongly enough disappears without needing to be destroyed.

sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure makes \+ Goal succeed when Goal cannot be proven from the program.
sketches.resonance: The system calls something lost not because it saw loss, but because it failed to find a path.
sketches.draft:
reachable(X) :- path(X).
lost(X) :- \+ reachable(X).
path(home) :- fail.
?- lost(home).
